body:
The leadership teams from Core States Group and Hurley & Stewart stand together: (left to right) Chris Jensen, Bryan Grabon, Tim Stewart, Dave Dugan, Todd Hurley, Carla Driver and Josh Harlan. (Core States Group)

Construction and architecture firm Core States Group has expanded its footprint to the Michigan market by acquiring a civil engineering company with locations in Kalamazoo and Grand Rapids.

From business and government to philanthropy, education and the arts, these are the leaders shaping West Michigan.
